title: Reliable Calls and Notifications
notes: Improves call continuity when Connect is backgrounded or the phone is locked, and fixes audio-route crashes when answering or ending calls.
Incoming calls show caller identity with native Answer and Decline controls, a repeating ringtone, and full-screen handling when locked.
Unlocked incoming calls use the heads-up alert without automatically replacing your current Connect page.
Adds notification, full-screen call, and background-access settings links.
Improves pending-call replay and message notification recovery with Nexus Notify.
